Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Shalini - 35 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Siya - 13 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Vimla - 69 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Rishabh - 11 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Aarav stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Vimla stand near him.]

Vimla: "Aarav, what's the plan today?"

[Aarav opens his umbrella.]

Vimla: "How beautiful!"

[Aarav puts on his raincoat.]

Aarav: "Wow, how lovely!"

[The rain stops.]

Vimla: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Aarav: "Mom, look over here."

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Shalini: "And then?"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Aarav: "How beautiful!"

[Flower petals rain down on Aarav.]

Aarav: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Aarav: "Hmm, I see."

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Shalini: "That's great!"

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Aarav: "Careful!"

[Aarav lights a bonfire.]

Shalini: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Shalini and Siya stand near him.]

Aarav: "What a nice place."

[Aarav serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Aarav: "Okay, Mom."

[Aarav sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Aarav: "Siya, look at this."

[Aarav writes in his notebook.]

Aarav: "Mom, listen!"

[Aarav sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Aarav: "That was fun!"

Scene 4: The snowy hillside - Day

Aarav: "Let's begin."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Shalini: "Good job, Aarav!"

[Aarav makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Aarav (laughing): "Mom, listen!"

[Aarav builds a snowman.]

Shalini (gently): "I knew it!"

[Aarav catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Aarav: "And then?"

[Aarav slides down the snowy slope.]

Aarav: "What a day to remember!"
